closure_rule: PROJECT_ASSUMPTION_FOR_B3: finish entered edge at entry-state duration; replan at every node using current state; never enter a closed edge
refueling: NONBINDING_REFUELING_V1_ASSUMPTION: zero-duration atomic transfer at site; reject insufficient station inventory or tank overflow
simultaneous_event_order: finish intervals, update road state, process vehicles by ascending ID and each vehicle action sequence
service_fuel_exhaustion: stop generation at exact exhaustion; remain parked until requested service end
action_timing: per-vehicle sequential queue; at_h is earliest start; no preemption
